info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Hauyne Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Hauyne Drill Detail Catalog API enables the creation of detailed catalogs for Hauyne drill specifications. This API streamlines the process of defining and managing drill details, allowing product managers and engineers to maintain accurate and comprehensive records. Users can input essential specifications and descriptions to enhance product visibility and support informed decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include manufacturing teams, product development units, and inventory management systems looking to integrate detailed catalog information.

post.summary: Create details for a Hauyne drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit details related to a Hauyne drill. Utilize this functionality to provide necessary specifications and data for the drill operation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details regarding the Hauyne drill operation. Ensure that the data provided adheres to the specified schema for correct processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the expected details.

quantity.description: The quantity of hauyne drills requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.
